rows.grounds: object employed in the ritual act
compound denoting the purpose of subjugating a man; locative of purpose

items.question: What quantity of mustard seeds is required for the subjugation of a man?
premises: The ritual context specifies acts directed toward controlling others.
Mustard seeds are prescribed as the ritual material.
A specific quantity is stipulated for subjugating a man.
items.inference: One thousand mustard seeds are to be used for the subjugation of a man.
uncertainties: The exact ritual procedure accompanying the use of the mustard seeds is not stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: But for the subjugation of a man, one thousand mustard seeds are used.
